_comment: Plain string = property tier only (warm/grand). Object form adds picker fields: mood+feel make a track pickable by agents; omit tier to leave it eligible in every tier; auto:false keeps it out of the automatic pick. Jane accepted the small Content-ID risk for the registered tracks given a mood (2026-10-12); test/swap over time. A tier kept alongside a mood leaves auto-selection exactly as before. raw:true = unprocessed download; trimmed + loudness-normalized (-9.8 LUFS) at render time. Leave it off for pre-processed files.

soft_piano.mp3.feel: Soft, unhurried solo piano. Gentle and homely.

acoustic_upbeat.mp3.feel: Bright, light acoustic guitar. Cheerful and friendly.

minimal_piano.mp3.feel: Sparse, soft piano — calm and hopeful.

reading.mp3.feel: Unhurried solo piano — steady and refined.

ambient_piano_strings.mp3.feel: Soft piano with gentle strings — calm and bright.
